/.title: Free. Libre. Truly Free.
/.line: Free the code. Reward the stewards. Give people their time back.

/manifesto/.title: The Jolly Roger Manifesto
/manifesto/.line: Software should be free. Stewardship should be rewarded. Human attention is precious.

/stewardship/.title: The Open Stewardship Economy
/stewardship/.line: Earning a good living from free software, without lock-in. A proposal, not a proven model.

/get-involved/.title: How can I help test this?
/get-involved/.line: Become a steward, consider paying one, or challenge the idea.

/pilot/.title: Stewardship Pilot
/pilot/.line: One steward, one free application, five to ten paying customers. Proposed, not started.
